page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.4xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance featuring custom AWS Graviton processors built on the arm64 architecture. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the r9gd.4xlarge includes a bundled 950 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, offering low-latency local storage directly attached to the hypervisor. The instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance type.

The combination of high memory density and local NVMe storage makes this instance type efficient for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space. The arm64 architecture offers resource density and power efficiency advantages over traditional x86 platforms. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
